Meta.title: Okhana — Family. Together. Always.
Meta.description: A family app for shared tasks with notifications, notes, a calendar, and birthdays — with private notes that stay private.
Meta.ogDescription: Family. Together. Always. Tasks, notes, and important dates — without the group-chat chaos.

Home.headline: Family life — without the endless group chat
Home.pitch: Tell Okhana: “remind Dad to pick up Sofia.” He gets a notification. Notes, birthdays, and who’s doing what live in one app. What isn’t for everyone stays out of sight.

problem.title: Usually one person keeps it all in their head
problem.body: School pickup, milk, Grandpa’s birthday — then another reminder in WhatsApp that everyone scrolls past. Okhana puts it in one place: write what needs doing, and the right person hears about it.

features.title: Write the way you already talk
features.subtitle: Text or voice — no maze of menus. After you sign up, you’ll see this same screen.

chat.title: Plain words, like messaging family
chat.body: “Remind Mom to call the school.” “Remember Sofia is allergic to peanuts.” “What’s on this week?” Okhana answers and can create the task or note right away. Hands full? Hold the mic.

wins.title: What Okhana helps with day to day
wins.subtitle: The whole family sees what’s shared. Private stays private — for the people you choose.

tasks.title: Ask someone — their phone gets a notification
tasks.body: Say “remind Dad…” or pick a person. They get notified, mark it done, and you stop chasing the group thread.

notes.title: Save what matters. Hide what should stay quiet
notes.body: Allergy info can be for everyone. A gift plan for Dad can be hidden from him. Kids and adults see what you allow.

calendar.title: Birthdays and events — with reminders in advance
calendar.body: A shared calendar and memorable dates. Reminders a week, three days, or a day ahead. Morning and evening — a short list on your phone.

phone.title: An icon on your home screen, like any other app
phone.body: Add Okhana to your home screen and turn on notifications — so you’re not digging through browser tabs.

privacy.title: A surprise stays a surprise
privacy.body: Planning a gift for Dad? Kids shouldn’t see that note — and Okhana shouldn’t spill it if Dad asks “what’s new?” Each person only sees what they’re allowed to.
privacy.step1Body: Okhana knows which family member is in the chat.
privacy.step2Body: Private notes and “adults only” content don’t reach everyone else.
privacy.step3Title: Answers only from what you can see
privacy.step3Body: Okhana only uses the notes and facts you’re allowed to see.

one.title: Create your family
one.body: Sign up, choose a name, and get an invite code.

two.title: Invite the people you live with
two.body: Partner and kids join with the code. Roles: owner, adult, or child.

three.title: Message Okhana
three.body: Ask for a reminder, save a note, or check the week. It builds up as you use it.

closing.title: You can start today
closing.body: Set up the family once. After that, just message Okhana when you need to.

demo.tasksSubtitle: Due soon — same as in the app
demo.tasksHint: Dad gets a notification when you assign him a task.
demo.chatUser1: Remind Dad to pick up Sofia at 6:30
demo.chatAssistant1: Done — I created a task for Marco: pick up Sofia at 6:30. He’ll get a notification.
demo.chatAssistant2: You have “Buy birthday candles” due tomorrow. Marco still has pickup at 6:30.
demo.noteSharedBody: Always check labels. EpiPen in the kitchen drawer.
demo.notePrivateBody: Order by Thursday. Hide the receipt in the desk.
demo.notePrivateMeta: Only Mom · Okhana won’t mention this to Dad

Home.heroPromptLead: Write to Okhana like a person:
Home.heroPromptExample: “Remind Dad to pick up Sofia at 6:30”
Home.heroPromptHint: Okhana figures out who to notify and when.
Home.pitchShort: Okhana helps remember the things you usually have to remind each other about.
Home.problemCaption: Less worrying. More time for what matters.
Home.winsAside: Important things don’t get lost. They just stay close.

winsPrivacy.title: Personal stays personal
winsPrivacy.body: Not everything Okhana knows should be family-wide. Private notes and tasks stay with the people you trust.

installWizard.iosStep1: Open this page in Safari (not an in-app browser from a messenger).

installWizard.androidStep2: Tap “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
